prompt:
Create ONE original character-design lineup sheet for a first-person noir comic game set in a fictional old East Asian river port. Use the supplied image ONLY as reference for the 2D character drawing language: confident black outer contours, thinner interior marks, two or three broad flat shadow shapes, muted workwear colors, believable ordinary adult people. Fallen Aces inspired graphic-novel game art, not photorealism, not 3D models, not anime, no superhero anatomy.
SIX DISTINCT full-body adult characters, in a clean three-column by two-row layout on a plain warm-gray background with ample separation. Entire head, hands and shoes visible. These are coherent residents/workers capable of bare-knuckle brawling, with distinct silhouettes and faces. Left-to-right top row:
1. Lean male courier, rust-red rolled-sleeve shirt, dark flat cap, dark loose trousers, small olive satchel kept close to hip. Alert relaxed posture, hands visible.
2. Broad heavy male dock porter, dark charcoal sleeveless vest over muted cream work shirt, thick forearms, broad trousers, chunky boots; compact raised boxing guard.
3. Wiry adult female electrical mechanic, short dark bob hair, faded blue-green work blouse, short canvas apron, tool pouch close to belt, rolled sleeves; one hand raised ready to guard, no weapon.
Left-to-right bottom row:
4. Older lean male boatman, weathered face, gray-indigo short work jacket, soft cap, dark trousers, worn slip-on shoes; slightly bent balanced stance with hands ready.
5. Tall narrow male warehouse watchman, short hair and small mustache, desaturated brown knee-length work coat open over dark clothing, sensible boots; cautious raised-fist stance, coat silhouette clearly different.
6. Compact sturdy adult female cargo worker, mustard-ochre short jacket, dark head scarf tied close, wide dark work trousers, strong practical gloves; upright firm boxing guard.
Keep a shared restrained ink-and-flat-color style across every figure, human proportions, visually clear hands and shoulders, selective clothing folds, minimal tiny texture. Gentle neutral cool illumination with very restrained warm edge tone, no dramatic rim glow. No crowd, no scenery, no weapons, no blood, no injury. No words, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, insignia, branding, watermarks, captions or labels anywhere. This is one design comparison sheet, NOT an animation sheet; do not repeat characters or show action sequences.
notes: 六名原创成人角色的首轮造型比较图；非透明独立精灵、动作帧或可运行战斗资产。未代表用户选定六个具体设计。
